topNews.text: Endangered California Condor Flies into Oregon for the First Time in 122 Years
topNews.excerpt: Last month, a California condor flew into Oregon before returning after several hundred miles to its home in Redwoods National Park, becoming the first condor recorded in the state since 1904. topNews.text: Woman Rower Breaks Men’s Record for Fastest Solo Voyage from California to Hawaii
topNews.excerpt: As America celebrated its 250th Birthday, Kelsey Pflendler celebrated her own significant milestone—becoming the first American woman to row a boat from California to Hawaii alone. topNews.text: No Outstanding Coal Mining Applications Left in the UK After Council Refusal in Carmarthenshire
topNews.excerpt: After a Welsh council rejected plans to dig for 85,000 tons of coal, the UK has no outstanding proposals for coal mining anywhere in the country.
